purpose: Frozen illustrative offline filter settings; no motor dynamics fit or physical coefficients
phase_assumption: Logger phase after Blackbox PID timestamp is assumed in [0, allowance]; this unmeasured bound is only a sensitivity convention
proxy_policy: Equal-valued overlapping intervals retain one ambiguous cached identity with their intersection; disjoint/changed-valued feasible newer intervals create proxy identities. Earliest feasible timestamp is used. Exact packets are unknown.
freshness_policy: Require DShot-enable bit4, per-motor seen bit5+i, finite nonnegative RPM and unsaturated age0..32766; effective fresh additionally requires native conservative age and observer fresh
real_data_validation_scope: Compatibility, finite outputs, causality and stale handling. No exact packet count, true acceleration accuracy, command timing identification, loaded response or torque calibration. Raw PB0 is diagnostic only and unused.
